new_rows.control_detail: Scanner control: the concatenated-stream n-gram scan independently re-finds the two 5-gram repeats blind agent A5 reported from primary material alone (BMRNM p22:73/p48:224; OUNWM p28:224/p33:56) plus the claimed 7-gram at the claimed positions. new_rows.hypothesis: The repeated ciphertext 7-gram reported by R43 X0 item 4 / F3 s1 / blind A5 (p27:28, p54:70) exists in canon as claimed and is a usable alignment constraint for reset-keystream schemes.
new_rows.result: VERIFIED AND MEASURED. The 7-gram DJUBEIAE (indices 23 11 1 17 18 10 25) occurs at p27 pos 28 and p54 pos 70 and is the ONLY repeated 7-gram in the full 57-page concatenated canon stream (13,136 runes; expected matching pairs under uniform iid 0.0050). Word-gap patterns identical (001001) at both sites. NEW FACT: the p54 occurrence CROSSES the page boundary - p54 is 76 runes, positions 70-75 are its last six runes and the 7th matching rune is the FIRST rune of p55 (a solved page), so every per-page scan is structurally blind to this object (this lane's first scan returned zero and was corrected). Both p27 and p54 open red-head sections (map [0,3,6,7,8,15,23,27,33,39,40,53,54]); section offsets 28 and 70, the second site contiguous 70..76 in section coordinates. ANCHOR-AS-FALSIFIER: under the same-plaintext reading, the constraint K[o+28+j]=K[o+70+j] (j=0..6 section mode; j=0..5 plus K[o+34]=K[o+0] page mode) is satisfied by NONE of the 51 R44-R1 keys at ANY offset o in 0..200 - those streams with page/section resets cannot produce LP2 under that reading.

new_rows.result: NEGATIVE (measured, panel-R36). Tier 1: 51 keys (P-prime, P-totient, P-phi + bash-4.2-LP64 $RANDOM mod 29 for seedprior20 top-40 + 8 Cicada integers) x 30 offsets x 6 configs (vig+/-, Beaufort, each x atbash) x 3 reset modes (page/line/section) x 55 pages = 1,514,700 cells, 0 crossers; global best pmax 5.631 (page 47, G-bash-1358633868, line, o=26, beau_atb, L=274) vs bar of record 21.101 - 15.5z below, no near-miss. The 7-gram-anchored offset extension is EMPTY: no swept key satisfies the same-plaintext constraint at any offset 0..200 (page or section mode), so the anchor independently excludes all 51 streams under page/section resets. Tier 2: reset-aware keyskip1 beam (the R33-I2 relation_skip_by_k patch, adapted and applied to real data for the first time) on the top-20 tier-1 cells: best pmax 5.423, 0 crossers.
